name: POV Short
summary: A short clip that shows a scene as if the viewer is a character: the camera is the viewer's eyes and the actor talks straight to the lens. A text line that starts with "POV:" sets the scene.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make the viewer the second person in the scene: the caption names the situation, the lens is the viewer.
design_principles: Start the clip with a title line that begins with "POV:" at 48 px, centred at 18% of the frame height.
Shoot with a phone held at eye level, a wide lens of 24 mm equivalent, and a small, steady shake.
Have the actor look into the lens for at least 60% of the clip.
Keep the clip between 7 s and 20 s, with one joke or turn at the end.
Use a single room and 1 to 2 props.
Put the 1 line caption in white on a 70% black bar, 40 px, so the situation is clear.
Cut once or twice at most; hold the take for 3 s to 8 s.
anti_patterns: Text that does not name the role of the viewer
Studio lighting with a perfect set

layout.grid_mechanics: A single vertical frame with a title line at 14% to 22% of the height and a caption zone at 68% to 80%.
layout.whitespace_ratio: A close shot fills 70% of the frame; the rest is a plain room.
layout.alignment_rules: The face and the lens sit at the centre; the title line is centred; props appear at the frame edge.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangle video; the title bar is a 70% black strip with 12 px radius.

font_pairings.note: One neutral family; weights give the hierarchy.
A system-like sans that looks like the default app font.

hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for the POV line and regular (400) for the rest.
Set the POV line at 48 px.
Use a black bar behind white text.
Keep the POV line to 10 words.

color.palette_structure: Plain room colours with white text on a black bar and one blue accent for the "POV" tag.
color.contrast_rules: White on the black bar gives 18:1; the blue tag has white text at 3.7:1 on 24 px bold only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat bars over live video; no gradients.
color.light_and_shadow: Practical room light: a lamp at 3200 K and a window; a face lit from the front at low contrast.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone camera in a real room: slight noise, wide-angle edge stretch.
materiality.border_rules: None on the video; the title bar has a 0 border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a 24 px black gradient at the top helps the title.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid 24 px icons in the app rail.
ornamentation_details.illustration: None; the person and the room are the picture.

motion.transition_physics: A hold of 3 s to 8 s with a slight handheld sway of 4 px; one cut at the turn; the caption appears in 100 ms.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on the caption pauses the clip.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels placed inside a small scene and smiles.

avoid_when: The message needs a view of many places.
The actor cannot look at the lens.

modifiers.how: Use a tripod, a mic and a colour grade.
Add the viewer's answer in a second panel.
Add 4 cuts and speed ramps on the punchline.

pack.why: A filled, neutral family that looks like the default app rail.

ground.why: The ground is a raw, flat dark room that holds the frame of a phone video.

tailwind.classes: rounded-xl bg-[#3A86FF] px-6 py-3 text-base font-bold text-[#111214]
